maria (sec-eng): heads up — we found a cluster of images built from the scratch-base branch that still have the old signer role attached. need an RBAC rollback plan before the rebuild window.
kevin (infra): ack. which role exactly?
maria (sec-eng): serviceAccount:image-signer@infra-prod. It has broad access to the keystore. we want to rotate to image-signer-minpriv and rebind only cosign signer perms.
sarah (runtime): can we do a canary rebuild with signed artifacts pointing to the new signer? build-bot will need a key access path change.
build-bot: CI note: pipeline job "image-bake" currently uses /var/run/keystore/signer-priv. New path must be /var/run/keystore/signer-minpriv or job will fail.
james (oncall): timeline? we have a partial incident from yesterday (CVE triage) that increased load. prefer evening window but can do staggered.
maria (sec-eng): plan: 1) create image-signer-minpriv role + tighten KMS decrypt policy 2) test canary image build in staging 3) run vulnerability scan + attest step 4) promote and sign prod images 5) remove old binding after rollout
kevin (infra): RBAC change needs approver from cloud-ops. pinging @cloud-ops. also need audit log entries for role creation.
sarah (runtime): for canary, suggest these flags: 
```
CI_IMAGE_TAG=canary-privatten 
BAKE_ARGS="--attest --cosign-key /var/run/keystore/signer-minpriv"
```
maria (sec-eng): good. also ensure we emit an ACL change event to stackdriver and a structured audit entry: "{actor: \"maria\", action: \"role.create\", role: \"image-signer-minpriv\"}"
james (oncall): note: when we cut the old binding, prepare an escape hatch: re-enable old role for 1 hour via feature flag and document rollback commands.
kevin (infra): KMS question: new role needs only AsymmetricSign on the signer key, not Decrypt. confirm?
maria (sec-eng): yes — AsymmetricSign only. Decrypt was too broad. We'll update keypolicy to limit to signer-minpriv.
sarah (runtime): will update the runtime to validate attestation chain. If cosign verification fails, fallback to read-only image from signed-cache.
build-bot: post-check: vulnerability scan step will output report to /artifacts/vuln-report-canary.json.
maria (sec-eng): one more: add a short audit-runbook entry in confluence (link later) and tag the rollout with incident-ref if anything spikes during rollout.
kevin (infra): I'll prepare the terraform diff and a preflight script to check existing bindings with: `gcloud iam roles describe image-signer` and `gcloud projects get-iam-policy`
james (oncall): I'll be on call during rollouts. ping me 15m before cut. if build failures happen, run: `tools/release/rollback_signer.sh --rebind-old`
maria (sec-eng): thanks team. I'll open the PR for the role + key policy and attach the canary CI job. keeping this thread for quick updates. :thumbsup:
